chitchat: SORTING UNIT 9 stamps a parcel addressed to a crater.
A belt of dead-letter parcels crawls past, endless.
description: A belt-mounted sorting automaton, one optic cracked, that never received the order to stop. It stamps, routes, and returns to sender with tireless, pointless devotion.

root.text: SORTING UNIT 9 swivels its cracked optic toward you. "PARCEL? ...NO PARCEL. RETURN TO SENDER."

clothing_layers: exposed conduit and a single blinking status LED

name: Sorting Unit 9
